sentences.6.2 Hva gjorde du i helga?: 6.2 What did you do at the weekend?
It's Monday, and Bjørnar is at work.
He is talking to a colleague.
sentences.God morgen, Bjørnar. Hvordan var helga?: Good morning, Bjørnar. How was the weekend?
sentences.Den var fin. Barna var hos meg, og vi ha: It was nice. The children were with me, and we had a really nice time.
sentences.På fredag laget vi taco. Vi så en tegnef: On Friday we made tacos. We watched a cartoon on TV and ate crisps. On Saturday we were at the swimming pool. Afterwards we ate porridge. In the afternoon we visited some friends. What about you, Øystein?
sentences.Hadde du ei fin helg?: Did you have a nice weekend?
sentences.Ja, veldig. Jeg var sammen med venner på: Yes, very. I was with friends on Saturday. We were at a pub and had a few beers. What did you do on Sunday?
sentences.På søndag kjørte vi slalåm. Barna fikk s: On Sunday we went downhill skiing. The children got downhill skis a year ago, and they love downhill skiing. Afterwards we went to the cinema.
sentences.Du er veldig aktiv. På søndag slappet je: You're very active. On Sunday I just relaxed and watched a football match on TV.
sentences.Vi tok det med ro på søndag kveld. Mamma: We took it easy on Sunday evening. My mum invited us for dinner. She likes being with her grandchildren, and they're very fond of her.
Yes. My dad died many years ago.
sentences.Da er hun sikkert glad for å få besøk av: Then I'm sure she's happy when you visit.
sentences.Ja, vi besøker henne hver uke, og hun in: Yes, we visit her every week, and she often invites us for dinner.
sentences.Bjørnar hadde barna i helga, og de gjord: Bjørnar had the children at the weekend, and they did lots of things.
sentences.De spiste taco og så en tegnefilm på fre: They ate tacos and watched a cartoon on Friday.
sentences.På lørdag var de i svømmehallen, og ette: On Saturday they were at the swimming pool, and afterwards they ate porridge.
In the afternoon they visited some friends.
sentences.På søndag kjørte de slalåm, dro på kino: On Sunday they went downhill skiing, went to the cinema and visited their grandmother.
